description: Calculate deterministic stock, ETF and investment profit, fees, distributions and percentage return from user-provided assumptions; no market quotes or recommendations. One call costs 0.01 USDC on Base x402; customer-owned provider credentials use X-Provider-Key header where needed.

distributions_total.description: Total received distributions or dividends, default 0

entry_price.description: Assumed entry price per share, greater than zero

exit_price.description: Assumed exit price per share, zero or greater

shares.description: Number of shares, greater than zero

total_fees.description: Combined entry and exit charges, default 0

name: api_investment_return
